'''Ancestral archives''' was a bubble building located on [[Ohma-D'un/Legends|Ohma-D'un]] where [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] went to find out about their ancestors. The bubble's archives contained the family histories of all Gungan families. This information was central to [[Gungan society]] because Gungans worshiped their ancestors.
